content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DBRAU Agra Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University Agra (DBRAU Agra) for hiring temporary academic staff.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under DBRAU Agra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 15 vacancies available for various Guest Faculty and Instructor positions across multiple academic departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to directly report to the designated venue on the scheduled interview date.

faq.question: Q4. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is officially scheduled to take place on 15 October 2026 at the specified university campus venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for DBRAU Agra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/- through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of Finance Officer, Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's or Bachelor's Degree in the relevant professional discipline with at least 55% marks, along with NET, SLET, SET, or a Ph.D. where applicable.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: Candidates must report to the University Guest House, Swami Vivekanand Campus, Khandari, Agra on the interview date starting at 10:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You must bring the prescribed application form, a Demand Draft for the fee, one self-attested set of academic and supporting documents, and all original certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for DBRAU Agra Guest Faculty and Instructors?
faq.answer: The positions offered under advertisement number RW/04/2026 are temporary in nature, meant to support various specialized university programs.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification details?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification PDF link provided in the important links section of this article to access complete details.
